mapper.sql: exists (select 1 from sys_user xu where xu.user_id = #{userId} and xu.user_type = 'INTERNAL')
not exists (select 1 from sys_comp_module xm where xm.module_cd = p.module_cd and xm.use_yn = 'N')
exists (select 1 from sys_user_auth xa join sys_auth_group xg on xg.comp_cd = xa.comp_cd and xg.auth_grp_cd = xa.auth_grp_cd and xg.use_yn = 'Y' and xg.admin_yn = 'Y' where xa.user_id = #{userId})
mapper.select: select distinct ap.action_cd from sys_user_auth ua join sys_auth_group g on g.comp_cd = ua.comp_cd and g.auth_grp_cd = ua.auth_grp_cd and g.use_yn = 'Y' join sys_auth_prog ap on ap.comp_cd = ua.comp_cd and ap.auth_grp_cd = ua.auth_grp_cd join sys_prog p on p.prog_cd = ap.prog_cd and p.use_yn = 'Y' where ua.user_id = #{userId} and ap.prog_cd = #{progCd} and ap.action_cd = any (p.actions) and union select unnest(p.actions) from sys_prog p where p.prog_cd = #{progCd} and p.use_yn = 'Y' and and ((p.self_service_yn = 'Y' and ) or )

select g.home_prog_cd from sys_user_auth ua join sys_auth_group g on g.comp_cd = ua.comp_cd and g.auth_grp_cd = ua.auth_grp_cd and g.use_yn = 'Y' join sys_prog p on p.prog_cd = g.home_prog_cd and p.use_yn = 'Y' where ua.user_id = #{userId} and and ((p.self_service_yn = 'Y' and ) or or exists (select 1 from sys_user_auth ua2 join sys_auth_group g2 on g2.comp_cd = ua2.comp_cd and g2.auth_grp_cd = ua2.auth_grp_cd and g2.use_yn = 'Y' join sys_auth_prog ap on ap.comp_cd = ua2.comp_cd and ap.auth_grp_cd = ua2.auth_grp_cd where ua2.user_id = #{userId} and ap.prog_cd = g.home_prog_cd and ap.action_cd = 'SEARCH')) order by g.sort_no, g.auth_grp_cd limit 1

select distinct ap.prog_cd from sys_user_auth ua join sys_auth_group g on g.comp_cd = ua.comp_cd and g.auth_grp_cd = ua.auth_grp_cd and g.use_yn = 'Y' join sys_auth_prog ap on ap.comp_cd = ua.comp_cd and ap.auth_grp_cd = ua.auth_grp_cd join sys_prog p on p.prog_cd = ap.prog_cd and p.use_yn = 'Y' where ua.user_id = #{userId} and ap.action_cd = 'SEARCH' and union select p.prog_cd from sys_prog p where p.use_yn = 'Y' and 'SEARCH' = any (p.actions) and and ((p.self_service_yn = 'Y' and ) or )
select prog_cd, prog_nm_key, view_path, module_cd from sys_prog where prog_cd = #{progCd} and use_yn = 'Y'

select m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_nm, m.menu_nm_key, m.prog_cd, p.prog_nm_key, m.sort_no from sys_menu m left join sys_prog p on p.prog_cd = m.prog_cd where m.use_yn = 'Y' and (m.prog_cd is null or p.use_yn = 'Y') order by m.sort_no, m.menu_id
